scientific_integrity: A direct proof is provided, independently cross-checked against raw graph definitions for finite orders; no claim of independent mathematical validation, priority certification, or general computer-assisted proof.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for complete graphs with each edge subdivided exactly once.
Finite checking is exhaustive only through n=5; tests of n=6,7,8 check predicted sets but are not exhaustive.
Publication priority is provisional; a related graph-operations paper was accessible only by abstract.
title: Maximal edge-open-packing sets in once-subdivided complete graphs
